analysis: Examined both BASE test excerpts and the bounded addition patch in provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCacheTests.swift. The visible addition at HEAD 3140 tests that a previously recognized DBK3 file loses maintenance ownership after header corruption despite restoring its size/mtime; the next partially visible test concerns replacing a malformed lookalike with an owned block. These expectations support T-041/TB-007 filesystem ownership and cleanup constraints rather than demonstrating a regression. BASE 3039–3290 covers epoch-preserving eviction, temporary-file budget accounting, malformed-file preservation, symlink rejection and periodic maintenance. BASE 3293–3728 covers donation benefit floors, staging limits, bounded write queues and outcome accounting. BASE 3731–4237 covers sidecar geometry, HMAC domain/scope separation, position commitments rather than plaintext positions, authenticated corruption fallback, default-off behavior and production donation dispatch. Those surrounding tests are unchanged according to the complete range map; they do not establish current implementation correctness. No changes to authorization, attestation, transport encryption, billing or privileged execution are evidenced here. Integration should inspect the runtime maintenance/header-verdict changes for descriptor-bound identity, modification detection, bounded cache growth and races before unlinking, alongside T-041 storage-volume and no-follow contracts. The added HEAD 3140–3240 test range is not fully supplied, and runtime implementation is absent from this batch; these are coverage limits, not findings or evidence of safety.
